name: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited
summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited trades in ayurvedic products in India and internationally. It operates through Ayurvedic products/medicine, Ayurvedic healthcare services, and others segments. The company offers ayurvedic products under the Shuddhi brand name. It also provides services, including in-patient, out-patient, 72 hours health camps, Panchakarma therapies, dietary support and nutrition guidance, home-based healthcare services, and healthcare support centre services.
